Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: PR18 merge 568ce108 is an ancestor of main. FrozenComponentConfirmation arithmetic, separately refitted reduced heads, independent R fixture and engineering CI are delivered. Component inference remains PendingFrozenProtocol; categorical/dependent association is unavailable.

Fresh context: Yes: scientific continuation.

Next action: Connect the delivered per-unit loss/score outputs to an admitted reference/randomization contract, then frozen scientific calibration. Preserve metric, equal-unit weights, complete families and all refusals.

Evidence: docs/verification/umvpa-component-confirmation-20261003.md; latest PR18 landing note; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Objective
Provide separate frozen-score association and held-out full-versus-reduced predictive loss estimands. Refit the reduced head on training when assessing adjusted component usefulness.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements INF-03, INF-01, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
statistical implementation; component confirmation estimands; small predictive head fitting and held-out loss reducers. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M4.04, M4.02. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Correlated/oblique factor fixtures distinguish a fixed-parameter ablation from usefulness after reduced-head refitting.
2. Trials, blocks, runs or subjects are inferential units as designed; overlapping CV folds are not independent samples.
3. Loss sign, weights, class/feature target metric and missing-unit policies are explicit.
4. Component coordinates and family are discovery-frozen; multiple views do not silently gain separate uncorrected confirmation claims.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
